title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Olivia Chen
description: This PR adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and end-to-end tool-calling examples, plus docs quickstarts and nav updates on the docs site. Motivation: provide reproducible, production-relevant examples for engineers evaluating RAG+agent patterns with Redwood (embeddings+retrieval, prefix caching, tool-calling). The change set includes YAML templates for common retrieval pipelines, three agent examples that demonstrate calendar/search/HTTP tool-calls, a small runtime-compatible agent wrapper used by the examples, and updated MkDocs pages and quickstart walkthroughs. Checklist: add templates and sample prompts; include runnable examples for Python and TypeScript; update docs nav and quickstart pages; add unit/integration tests for the agent harness; run docs build and fix any site issues; tag examples in redwood-examples and reference from docs. Testing: local unit tests + examples smoke tests run in CI; docs site built in CI and validated. Backwards compatibility: examples are additive and opt-in; no API surface break. See linked Linear tickets for rollout plan and follow-up improvements.
